notes: The P03 tracked scope retains exact public query text, method/algebra text, safe aggregate counts and statuses, hashes, and restricted-location references only. It retains no raw record identity, title, abstract, DOI, author list, native export, credential, cookie, profile path, session/search URL, account/institution/IP context, raw HTML, screenshot, target identifier, or websocket identifier. Final structural validation repeats the prohibited-pattern scan after manifest/evidence generation.
